mutation_requested.description: Run-scoped consent to the opt-in MUTATION stage (local-pilot-v1 only).

require_driver_isolation.description: Accept only review parts run by a driver-launched process (isolation_evidence DRIVER_PROCESS).

suite_requested.description: Run-scoped consent to write the living suite after the terminal result (local-pilot-v1 only, wave 3).

disposition_policy.description: Opt-in disposition policy after FAIL: keep passing generated tests, mark failed methods (local-pilot-v1 only, wave 3).

execution_review_required.description: execution.review human (S3): the execution starts only after EXECUTION_APPROVED of the exact generated files (local-pilot-v1 only).

context_confirm_required.description: context.confirm (S5): no model request before CONTEXT_CONFIRMED of the exact requirements snapshot and selected files.

execution_mode_human.description: execution.mode human (S9): the package starts no build, test or mutation process; a person runs the printed commands and returns the reports (local-pilot-v1 only).

design_full_factorial_max.description: design.full_factorial_max (D1b, default 16): a group of parameters with at most this many combinations of valid partitions is combined in full, a larger one pairwise; the journal recomputes the combinations from it.

design_required.description: design.enabled (D1, on by default): the test-design stage runs after the context marker, every generator request binds its design slice and every case names design elements.
